label: Every actual participant has at most the selected actual source's represented degree of esse
paraphrase: Analyst formulation. The selected s is actual as to esse. Each actual q44 participant x satisfies degree(esse,x) ≤ degree(esse,s) in one fixed preorder. This is a positive weak bound on the represented scale and allows equal degrees. Passing to the primitive comparative, excluding ties, and extending the comparison to a different perfection each require additional warrant.
